title: Why the Discovery of the First Short-Tailed Tsushima Leopard Cat Worried Researchers - Nautilus
gist: Camera traps on Japan's Tsushima island caught at least three short-tailed Tsushima leopard cats, alarming researchers because the population of only ~150 animals makes such a trait a possible sign of threatening genetic problems.
